for the State. 
Heard Mr. J.S. Virk, the learned Deputy Advocate 
General appearing for the State. 
Since this appeal is filed under Section 374(2) of 
the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the appeal is 
admitted. 
Call for the scanned/photocopies of the 
TCRsalongwith soft copy of the same. 
List this case after the receipt of the TCRs.

Legal Services Authority is hereby directed to engage 
an Amicus Curiae to argue the case on behalf of the 
appellant, in light of the observations made by the 
Hon’ble Supreme Court in the case ofAnokhiLal v. 
State of Madhya Pradesh, (2019) SCC Online SC 
1637.
